title: CompiledPlan
description: The validated, structured output of natural-language plan compilation. This is the ONLY form in which a plan may be activated. Free text is never executed. Produced by the agent, validated deterministically, previewed by a human, and only then turned into a PlanVersion.

type.description: Which of the four plan templates this compiles to.

label.description: Human-facing plan name, e.g. 'Evening check'. Shown in the preview.

timezone.description: IANA timezone. Required: a plan without an explicit zone is ambiguous across DST and travel, which would silently move a safety deadline.

timeOfDay.description: RECURRING only. 24-hour local time in the plan's timezone.

daysOfWeek.description: RECURRING only. Omit for every day.

intervalSeconds.description: RECURRING with a repeating interval, e.g. 'every three hours tonight'.

seconds.description: Acceptable uncertainty before escalation begins. Missing does not mean danger; grace is what encodes that.

steps.description: The escalation ladder, ordered. Offsets are measured from the end of the grace window.

stopConditions.description: The only ways this Alert may close successfully. A delivered notification or a mere acknowledgement is NEVER a stop condition.

contextPolicy.description: Progressive context release. Everything defaults to NEVER; the user opts in explicitly, in advance.

leaseSeconds.description: Checking-lease duration. A responder claiming an Alert pauses backup escalation for this long. Acknowledged is not resolved.

offsetSeconds.description: Seconds after escalation start. Must be non-decreasing with sequence; validated semantically, not by schema.

action.description: PUSH_SUBJECT and MESSAGE_* are P0 channels. CALL_* remain first-class in the schema but report CHANNEL_UNAVAILABLE until Amazon Connect lands in P1 - see docs/PRD.md section 12.

targetRole.description: Required for responder-directed actions. The agent selects a ROLE, never a person and never an endpoint.

releaseLevel.description: When a context signal may be released. Ordered least to most permissive.
